title: TextFlint: Unified Multilingual Robustness Evaluation Toolkit for Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Entity-based transformation that detects human names in texts and replaces them with names associated with a specific gender (e.g., replacing male names with female names) to evaluate performance drops in Natural Language Inference and Coreference Resolution tasks.
Entity-based transformation that detects location entities in texts and replaces them with locations from a specific region to evaluate model robustness and measure performance disparities.
